restart.title: Restart this match?
restart.note: The score resets to 0–0. Your lineup and map stay the same.
knockout.label: Cat knockout animation
knockout.note: Applies to future knockouts without restarting. Characters with split art use the selected animation. Reduced motion keeps the short fade.
motion.label: Animation
motion.reducedStatus: Active: reduced motion, short fade only
map.fallback: Map unavailable. Using the default pool.
plugin.name: Meow Meow Bump Battle
plugin.description: A catgirl swimming-ring physics playground with pull-to-launch controls, water drag and bounce tuning.
ui.canvas: Swimming-ring pool. Pull a ring back and release to launch.
ui.hint: Pull a ring back and release. Try again once everything stops.
ui.tuningHint: Adjust while still. Reloading restores the defaults.
ui.placeholder: Three cats, three passive skills. Art and balance are still being refined.
state.idle: Pick a cat and try a shot
state.aiming: Release to launch · Esc to cancel
state.moving: Gliding — wait until the rings stop
state.error: Motion error. Please reset the pool.
note.free: Try a different angle and see where the rings go.
note.wall: Try straight and diagonal shots against the wall.
note.duel: Try a direct hit, then a glancing hit.
note.chain: Launch Juzi to the right and watch motion pass along.
note.corner: Aim into the corner to check crowded collisions.
hud.skipExtraOnLaunch: Shoot to skip Yui’s extra shot
ui.loadError: Unable to open the playground. Please reload this page.
ui.artNote: Launch by pulling the character or ring. The ring edge defines collisions.
ui.artMissing: The character image is unavailable. Placeholder play is still available.
battle.hint: Each cat launches once per round; ✓ means already acted. On your turn, any ally can damage enemies on contact; {opponent} turns reverse this.
battle.practiceNote: Practice has no damage or passive skills. Adjust the feel freely.
battle.tuningNote: Battle uses fixed defaults and character passives. Switch to practice to tune the feel.
state.playerTurn: Your turn · choose one of your cats
skill.0.name: Heavy paws
skill.0.description: Juzi has 1.6× mass. Equal launch energy gives her a slower start; impacts carry more weight.
skill.1.name: Super bouncy ring
skill.1.description: Pudding has higher wall restitution (0.97 instead of 0.90). Ring-to-ring bounce stays the same.
skill.2.name: Soft cushion
skill.2.brief: First hit each enemy action: −8 damage
skill.2.description: Milkcap reduces the first valid hit in each opposing action by 8. Later hits in that action deal full damage.
skill.3.name: Follow Through
skill.3.brief: A knockout during her shot gives Yui one extra shot
skill.3.description: Yui takes one extra shot if an opponent is knocked out during her shot, including by an ally. The extra shot cannot trigger this again.
skill.4.name: Petal Cheer
skill.4.brief: Heal each ally Lolita Yui directly bumps during her shot
skill.4.description: During her shot, each direct bump with an ally restores HP equal to Lolita Yui's attack, up to the ally's maximum HP.
opponent.name: 林悠怡
ui.launchHint: Drag a cat, release to launch
test.oneHitNote: Applies to both teams: valid hits knock out immediately, bypassing guard. Does not change current HP. Kept when restarting here; off after reload. Battle only.
test.oneHitActive: Testing: one-hit knockouts for both teams
camera.label: Camera timing
camera.gentle: New · gentle push, hold and follow
camera.note: Moving-camera modes only. Applies to future knockouts without restarting.
camera.focus: Trial · impact close-up and slow motion
contact.label: Trial: stronger impact feedback
contact.note: The ring compresses first and the body follows, with local flash and directional water. Applies to future momentum knockouts for supported cats; camera timing stays unchanged.
